'''Hokami''' were predators from [[Mutanda]]'s plains. They had great skill at sneaking through Mutanda's grasses unseen. They were very aggressive and would attack virtually any creature. They were also known to attack [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicles with their sharp claws and their [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]].
